A nonzero-product group has alignment exponent at least-100; its smallest normalized nonzero carry has exponent-125 and needs no subnormal shift.

Certified groups retain the original integer carry, K16 exponent maximum, unsigned modulo sign decoder and final BF16 endpoint. Zero-product groups preserve tiny prior carries; no exponent clamping is used. Other rows use the unchanged validated-float or integer dot.

Only component headers and harness hooks are added. Existing whole,MoE,CK dispatchers and original arithmetic headers remain unchanged. Original PPB1000 candidates are preserved; external reference data is comparison-only.
